name: assert-real-inspector-seam
expression: new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const check=()=>{const inspector=document.querySelector('.measure-inspector'),button=document.querySelector('.rail-assistant-toggle');if(inspector&&button&&!document.querySelector('.live-assistant.is-open')){const r=inspector.getBoundingClientRect(),b=button.getBoundingClientRect();if(r.width>0&&getComputedStyle(inspector).visibility!=='hidden'&&Math.abs(b.left+b.width/2-r.left)<12){observer.disconnect();clearTimeout(timer);resolve({inspector:r.toJSON(),button:b.toJSON(),text:inspector.innerText})}}};const observer=new MutationObserver(check);observer.observe(document.body,{subtree:true,childList:true,attributes:true});const timer=setTimeout(()=>{observer.disconnect();reject(Error('Takeoff inspector seam unavailable or misaligned'))},6000);check();})
